cc:Work.dc:title: prompt compliance
cc:Work.dc:description: Each model is asked for the same persona-scenario grid under a binary JSON schema. Dark green cells were valid on the first attempt; light green cells became valid after one model-driven repair retry. Red and grey cells remain honest missing votes; no invalid response is converted into a fabricated vote.
